title: kate-syntax: keep the selection color off the line background
summary: selection_color returns TextSelection when that color differs from the background and the current line. A clash returns the fixed selection blue. The theme files stay as they are. Linux CI runs the test.

lane.reason: The work is pure Rust in the theme loader. Linux CI runs the test. It does not need a window or the owner's eyes.

data_contracts.schema_diff_summary: Add Theme::selection_color. Return TextSelection when that color is set and it differs from BackgroundColor and from CurrentLine. When TextSelection is absent, or it equals BackgroundColor, or it equals CurrentLine, return Rgba(0x94, 0xCA, 0xEF, 0xFF). Compare only the editor colors that the file sets. Leave the theme JSON files unchanged. Leave paint.rs unchanged. The paint path still reads TextSelection through colors_from_theme. Leave session.rs, lib.rs, and files.rs in kate-ui unchanged. PKT-0051 owns those files. Leave bar.rs unchanged. PKT-0067 owns that file. Branch from the current tip of main. base_sha records that tip at planning time. If main has moved, use the new tip.

regression_tests.name: theme::tests::selection_color_differs_from_the_line_background
regression_tests.asserts: This test fails on main because selection_color does not exist. Breeze light returns Rgba(0x94, 0xCA, 0xEF, 0xFF). A fixture whose TextSelection equals its BackgroundColor returns that same fallback. The fallback differs from the fixture background and from its current line.
